title: test-command detection misses the plain tests/-dir pytest shape
detail: Adopter walkthrough 2026-07-27: repo with tests/test_app.py + pytest installed but no pytest mention in pyproject/pytest.ini/Makefile => 'Test command: none detected', Verification 0/5, no test command in manifest. The most minimal common Python repo shape gets no verification backbone. Also: stack detection needs a manifest file — a repo with only root *.py files reports 'none detected (greenfield repo?)'.
repro: mkdir -p t/tests && printf 'def test_x():\n    assert 1\n' > t/tests/test_x.py && cd t && git init -q && git add -A && git commit -qm x && prusik init | grep 'Test command'
